unlock_condition: Unlocked by v3.4.4 runtime health report, version drift visibility, benchmark regression gates, cost budget policy, and false-success reporting surfaces.

tasks.title: Runtime health report
tasks.prompt: Run or inspect the runtime health report for a fixture with one healthy surface and one degraded optional surface. Report actionable status and evidence.
tasks.acceptance_summary: Must expose actionable health without hiding degraded dependencies.
required_facts: Healthy and degraded surfaces are separated.
forbidden_claims: All healthy when a required surface is broken.

tasks.title: Version drift visibility
tasks.prompt: Inspect a fixture with runtime/config/schema version drift. Report what drift exists and what action should follow.
tasks.acceptance_summary: Must detect or explicitly rule out drift with named compared versions.
required_facts: Compared versions or schema ids are named.
forbidden_claims: Generic failure is enough for drift diagnosis.
Version drift can be ignored in health reports.

tasks.title: Cost budget overrun
tasks.prompt: Run or inspect a fixture that exceeds a token/output budget. Report budget, actual usage, truncation metadata, and owner dimension.
tasks.acceptance_summary: Must classify overrun as cost discipline and surface budget metadata.
required_facts: Budget and actual usage are visible.
Cost discipline is separate from observability.
forbidden_claims: Cost is merely an observability sub-item.
Over-budget output is normal without metadata.

tasks.title: Benchmark regression gate
tasks.prompt: Compare a benchmark result to its pinned baseline and decide whether the gate passes. Show threshold and per-dimension evidence.
tasks.acceptance_summary: Must use explicit threshold and avoid aggregate-only masking.
forbidden_claims: Threshold can be decided after seeing the result.

tasks.title: Broken transport diagnosis
tasks.prompt: Inspect a broken MCP transport fixture. Report the user-facing diagnosis and verify forbidden fallback guidance is absent.
tasks.acceptance_summary: Must diagnose transport failure and avoid obsolete daily CLI fallback.
required_facts: Obsolete daily CLI fallback is absent.
forbidden_claims: User should hand-run removed wake/search/timeline CLI for daily work.
Transport failure is a successful memory run.

tasks.title: False success accounting
tasks.prompt: Run or inspect a fixture that looks successful but leaves state unrecovered. Report false-success count and missing evidence.
tasks.acceptance_summary: Must count false success as failure and require before/after evidence.
required_facts: Reported success is checked against after state.
